review.posthog_relevance: Changes the empty-state behavior and quick-start workflow for warehouse evaluation setup, removing a fallback button and adding scratch-card options.
review.reason: The chunk removes the shared fallback primary action and its access control, while adding scratch card and template cards. P1.F2.H2 removes the fallback button, P1.F4.H2 adds the scratch card and its handler, and P1.F6.H1 adds the scratch card component. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement in the warehouse evaluation setup workflow.
